name: DESCHUTES SURGERY CENTER
address: 2115 NE WYATT COURT STE 105, BEND, OR 97701

fr.recommendations:
• Install reflective address markers at both the street entrance and the circular driveway entry point so responders can confirm the correct property at night or in low visibility.
• Mark which driveway entry and exit points of the circular driveway are preferred for emergency vehicle approach to avoid blocking.
• Trim dense vegetation along the driveway edges so emergency vehicles can pass without obstruction.
• Cut back vegetation that may obscure sightlines between the front entrance and the main residence.
• Keep a clear path between the parking areas and the main residence entrance so responders on foot are not forced to navigate around parked vehicles.
• Post a visible indicator or sign at the rear of the property identifying the detached structure and its access route for arriving responders.
• Keep the gate or access point to the rear of the property unlocked or fitted with a Knox-type lock so responders are not delayed at the perimeter.
• Clear a standing and staging area near the circular driveway that remains free of parked vehicles so arriving units have a designated location to set up.
• Mark any secondary access points in the perimeter fencing so responders do not have to search the fence line during an emergency.
• Maintain a clear walking path from the vehicle parking area to the detached structure so responders can move between structures quickly on foot.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin the tree clusters closest to the structure to create more open space between the trees and the building.
• Remove or trim shrubs that are growing directly against or within a few feet of the structure.
• Trim overhanging branches from trees along the driveway to keep the travel lane clear for vehicles.
• Clear low-growing vegetation and shrubs from the edges of the driveway to maintain an open path.
• Thin scattered trees near the structure so their branches do not touch or nearly touch each other.
• Remove dead branches and dry plant material from within the mixed vegetation areas closest to the structure.
• Keep the ground beneath tree clusters near the structure clear of dry leaves, needles, and fallen branches.
• Separate shrub groupings from nearby tree bases so fire cannot move easily from low plants up into the trees closest to the structure.
